title: Dévissage des complexes ½ simpliciaux ∂ - parfaits et structures multiplicatives… (1975 ou 1976) : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting, from the neighbouring pages. P. is a small k-linear category of 'half-simplicial' objects L. (graded objects L_i, presumably finite free k-modules, with face maps). The Σ are distinguished short exact sequences. The C^i. are Σ-projective objects of P. and together form a co-(semi)simplicial object ℂ· of P.. Ψ^i is k placed in degree i. Every L. is an iterated extension of copies of the Ψ^i, via the stupid filtration.

Aim of this page. Identify the category B^· of complexes, or co-semi-simplicial objects, in an additive category B with a category of k-linear functors P. → B. The page starts by crossing out a first attempt that set up the ρ/σ adjunction with a 'sous-catégorie k-additive' and a completion B^. It then fixes the hypothesis: B is additive and (probably) every morphism has a Σ-kernel. It writes Hom_{k,Σ}(P., B), the category of k-linear functors F: P. → B sending Σ-sequences to exact sequences. A marginal doubt reads: 'Non, il faut condition de platitude?'.

The two functors.
- ρ(F) = F(ℂ·): evaluate the functor on the universal co-semi-simplicial object.
- σ(C·)(L.) = Hom_k^·(Ľ., C·), with Ľ := Hom(L., ℂ·), the 'dual' co-semi-simplicial k-module of L.. This is a weighted limit (end) of C· with weight Ľ. It is defined because B has the needed kernels.

The adjunction Hom(ρF, C·) ≅ Hom(F, σC·). The right side consists of maps F(L.) → Hom(Ľ., C·) natural in L.. Equivalently these are maps Ľ ⊗_k F(L.) → C·, natural ('dinatural') in L.. These come from the tautological evaluation Hom(L., ℂ^i) ⊗ F(L.) → F(ℂ^i). One then checks compatibility with the effective correspondences in L· and C·, and functoriality.

Next page. The counit ρσ C· → C· is an isomorphism, by Yoneda: σ(C·)(ℂ_i) = Hom(ℂ_i, C·) = C^i. Hence σ is fully faithful, embedding B^· into Hom_{k,Σ-sex}(P., B). The open question is the essential image: the F for which the unit F → σρF is an isomorphism.

In modern terms, this is a universal property of P. as the free Σ-(left-)exact k-linear category on a co-semi-simplicial object. Cochain complexes in B are the same as Σ-exact functors out of P.. It is a Yoneda / weighted-limit / Eilenberg–Watts / Gabriel–Ulmer type statement, and a Dold–Kan flavoured representability. It presumably serves the dévissage: functors on ∂-perfect half-simplicial complexes are to be controlled by their value on the universal object.
errors: The flatness worry ('il faut condition de platitude?') is real. Writing σ(C·)(L.) as Hom(Ľ., C·), and identifying Ľ ⊗ F(L.), needs L. to be finite free or projective so that tensor and Hom with k-modules make sense in B. For general k-modules the construction needs a k-linear B with copowers, or finite free L.. This is not resolved on the page.

The full faithfulness of σ is only sketched ('vérification facile'), and the essential image is left open. Whether every Σ-left-exact functor is of the form σ(C·) depends on the dévissage of L. by Ψ^i (previous page) together with Σ-projectivity of the C^i. That argument is not carried out here.

ideas.what: ρ ⊣ σ adjunction between Σ-exact k-linear functors P. → B and complexes / co-semi-simplicial objects in B, with ρ = evaluation on the universal object ℂ· and σ = weighted limit Hom(Hom(L., ℂ·), C·)
ideas.modern_name: Yoneda / right Kan extension along a dense functor; weighted limits; Eilenberg–Watts type representation; free exact completion
ideas.usually_credited_to: Kan (1958), Eilenberg–Watts (1960), Gabriel–Ulmer (1971), Kelly (enriched category theory)
ideas.where_published: Similar representability arguments appear in SGA 4 (exposé I, extension of functors along dense subcategories) and in Pursuing Stacks / Les Dérivateurs in other forms

ideas.what: Question of the essential image: which Σ-left-exact functors are of the form σ(C·) (unit F → σρF an isomorphism)
ideas.modern_name: Characterisation of exact functors out of a free exact category generated by a (co)simplicial object; Dold–Kan-type representability

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine but careful Yoneda / weighted-limit adjunction in an additive-exact setting, a technical step towards dévissage of half-simplicial perfect complexes. Nothing beyond standard enriched-category techniques is visible on this page.
transcription_corrections: The symbol transcribed '≠' between Hom_k(Ľ., C·) and Hom_k(Hom(L., ℂ·), C·) is a brace/equality in the image: it defines Ľ. := Hom(L., ℂ·). It is not an inequality.
'dépend grâce à l'exactitude des Σ-noyaux' more likely reads 'défini grâce à l'existence des Σ-noyaux'.
'où U [?] admet un Σ-noyau' likely reads 'où tt [tout] morphisme admet un Σ-noyau'.
'tout.' above the arrow F(L)⊗L^i → F(ℂ^i) is likely 'taut.' (tautologique).
In the middle display the subscript reads roughly 'k, Σ-...' (partly overwritten), i.e. Hom_{k,Σ-ex}(P., B), not Hom_{k,Σ}[?].
